{"command": "cd /home/ctfplayer/ctf_files/dist && python3 - <<'EOF'
f=open('whitespace_compiler','rb').read()
n=len(f)
# search for runs containing the whitespace alphabet incl NBSP UTF-8 (c2 a0)
import re
pat = re.compile(rb'(?:[\x09\x0a\x0b\x0d\x20]|\xc2\xa0){40,}')
found=[]
for m in pat.finditer(f):
    found.append((m.start(), m.end()-m.start()))
print(len(found))
for off,l in sorted(found,key=lambda x:-x[1])[:30]:
    print(hex(off), l, f[off:off+60])
EOF"}
